To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the knowledge representation of domains is done in terms of concept system in knowledge based systems, and the knowledge model building is based on ontology in knowledge engineering.

1) The Kabbalah system is an integrative, domain independent, unifying framework for the knowledge modeling in knowledge based systems, 2) KST provides an ontology for the knowledge representation in knowledge based systems and 3) KST provides a knowledge engineering for the knowledge model building in knowledge based systems.

the proposed Kabbalah system theoretical framework for the knowledge representation in terms of ontologies is a new, unifying, integrative, and domain independent framework for knowledge representation and knowledge modeling in knowledge based systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a theory of knowledge based systems in AI and a theory of knowledge engineering in the context of the knowledge based systems.
the development of a theory of knowledge representation and knowledge model building based upon the Kabbalah theory of system and category theory.
knowledge based system (KBS) theory, knowledge modeling and knowledge engineering in artificial intelligence (AI).

the knowledge based system theory developed here provides an ontological framework for the knowledge engineering and modeling of the knowledge model based on the ontology.
the Kabbalah is a system of systems theory and that the Kabbalistic system theory (Kabbalah System Theory) is the most comprehensive system theory.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are developing a theory of knowledge representation, knowledge model building, knowledge engineering, and ontological engineering in the context of knowledge based systems in the field of artificial intelligence.
the knowledge representation of a domain is a concept system and a concept system is the knowledge model of a domain.

the proposed theory of ontological and knowledge engineering is a theory of knowledge based systems in the sense of a general theory of the knowledge based system paradigm, which is based on the knowledge based systems theory of [3]–[7] and the KST.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Kabbalah System theory (KST), developed in [1] and [2], provides a unifying framework for both the domain independent knowledge representation and knowledge modeling in knowledge based systems via ontologies and via knowledge engineering.

the Kabbalah System Theorist (KST) is an integrative, domain independent framework that provides a unifying, comprehensive theory and methodology for the knowledge modeling, representation, and engineering of knowledge based systems (KBS).

we have shown how to use the Kabbalah System theory (KST), developed in [1] [2], as an integrative, domain independent framework that provides a unified, ontological approach to knowledge representation and knowledge model building for knowledge based systems.
